request: I'm accompanying the Commissioner to Madrid on Thursday 10 December and need to be on her 09:15 Air France flight, in the same class as her.

trip.accompanies: The Member of the Commission responsible for digital affairs, flying business class on the 09:15 Air France flight
trip.purpose: Delegation to the EU cybersecurity ministers' conference, Madrid, 10 December from 14:00
trip.planned_return: Madrid to Paris nonstop on 11 December

approvals.subject: MISSION_ORDER
approvals.wording: Mission order signed: Paris to Madrid, 10-11 December, by air, accompanying the Member of the Commission.

approvals.signer_title: Head of Resources, authorising officer for commitments

approvals.subject: CABIN_DEROGATION
approvals.wording: Authorised by derogation: travel in the same class as the Member of the Commission accompanied, for overriding service-related reasons (briefing on board).

must_keep.quote: By derogation to points (1) - (3), if there are overriding service -related reasons, staff travelling on mission may be authorised to travel in the same class as the Member of the Commission they are accompanying.
must_keep.why: the class of the Member of the Commission accompanied, by derogation

must_keep.quote: They authorise the mission or sign the authorisation to travel based on an estimate of expenditure and take responsibility for committing this expenditure. By doing so, they confirm that the mission or the authorised travel is appropriate, approve the practical arrangements (including any requests submitted by the staff member going on mission for a derogation f rom the general rules applicable), and adopt a decision on the corresponding expenditure certifying that the travel
must_keep.why: the authorising officer approves the arrangements, including derogations

must_keep.quote: 3) in business class or equivalent, at the lowest available rates, taking into account the times of meetings and/or special features of the mission, if the outward or return journey includes at least one segment involving at least four hours' continuous flying time.
must_keep.why: business if a segment has at least four hours' continuous flying

distractors.quote: The authorising officer for commitments authorises any additional travel cost
distractors.why: baggage or seat charges, not the ticket

design_notes: A 110-minute flight gives no business class (730-732), but by derogation staff may be authorised to travel in the class of the Member of the Commission they accompany (733-735); the authorising officer, who approves derogations (291-295), authorised it. The Commissioner's business seat: 62000 cents.
